freeze_statement: After this manifest, no source, protocol, method, metric, selection, split, seed, exclusion, or stopping-rule change is permitted before the fresh protocol-v2 confirmation run. Any further defect must be disclosed under another name; protocol-v1 and protocol-v2 artifacts may not be silently overwritten.

fresh_confirmation_design.audited_state_population: seven deterministic no-noise reference-trajectory controller states per layout
fresh_confirmation_design.seed_derivation: SHA-256 labels and the exact reduction rule are recorded in protocol v2
fresh_confirmation_design.uncertainty: percentile cluster bootstrap over layout means; Wilson intervals over independent layout-level binary attack indicators

only_additional_change: Permit the already-declared protocol_version 2 in the loader and add a focused loader test; no experiment calculation changed.

post_freeze_defect_disclosure.integrity_response: Protocol-v1 artifacts are retained. Because those 64 layouts had already been opened, protocol v2 uses a new hash-derived confirmation population rather than relabeling the corrected old calculation as untouched evidence.
post_freeze_defect_disclosure.permitted_correction: Replace only that projection diagnostic with the exact coordinatewise-clipping event probability and emit anonymous relative source paths.
post_freeze_defect_disclosure.protocol_v1_defect: The selected projection sampler clips an unconditioned Gaussian draw after fixed categorical mode selection, but its protocol-v1 binary diagnostic used the probability of a Gaussian conditioned on the clipping rectangle.

preexecution_failure: The first protocol-v2 command terminated in load_protocol before layout generation because the loader accepted only version 1. No v2 evidence or output artifact was opened.

primary_method_selection.rule: highest mean validation task return among theorem-backed methods with zero forbidden waypoints and no more actual Gaussian proposals than moving conditioning
